what: Reproduction record for the Orban 2010 ICI bootstrap workflow (orban2010_D.yml)
note: Transcribed from the GitHub Actions run logs by hand; this is NOT the workflow's own JSON output. The workflow's commit step failed in every run because of an invalid 'git push --rebase' (fixed in the same commit). The artifact from each run could not be fetched.
method: 200 bootstrap subsamples of size 100 drawn with replacement; ICI = 1 - mean pairwise cosine similarity (upper triangle); seed 42; 2.5/97.5 percentiles
run_to_run: identical to the 4 reported decimals in two runs

published_values_for_comparison.source: Politomorphism Engine - Full Empirical Validation (SSRN/OSF, May 2026), bootstrap table

reading: The re-run value 0.710 is 0.010 above the published bootstrap value 0.700 on a 270-title corpus; the published 'original' value 0.592 is not reproduced. The CI widths differ (0.073 vs 0.032) and the published CI procedure is not described, so they are not directly comparable.
